ios.desc:
WorkSplit – Work Photos. Organized.

Keep your work photos completely separate from your personal library. WorkSplit is built for professionals who need clarity, speed, and privacy – without the clutter.

Separate Work from Personal
Your job site photos, client documentation, and field work belong in one place – not mixed with family photos. WorkSplit keeps them cleanly apart, always.

Organized by Project
Create albums for clients, sites, or topics. Import from your photo library or shoot directly into a project. Everything stays exactly where it belongs.

Fast Capture, Zero Friction
A familiar camera interface gets out of your way. Tap, shoot, done. Unassigned photos land in your Inbox so nothing gets lost. Choose your photo resolution to save storage.

Privacy by Design
All data is stored locally on your iPhone. No third-party servers, no tracking, no surprises.

iCloud Sync – Your Data, Your Control
With WorkSplit Pro, your photos and albums sync securely across all your devices via iCloud. Data stays exclusively in your own iCloud – never on our servers.

Automatic Cloud Export – An Alternative to iCloud
Prefer Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, Nextcloud, or iCloud Drive? WorkSplit Pro can automatically export your photos and albums to a folder in your cloud storage – neatly organized by project. Choose either iCloud Sync or Automatic Cloud Export, whichever fits your workflow.

Built For
Architects, site managers, and tradespeople
Field teams and documentation professionals
Anyone who needs a clear work/personal divide

WorkSplit Pro
Unlimited albums and photos
iCloud sync across all devices (Wi-Fi or cellular)
Automatic Cloud Export (Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, Nextcloud, iCloud Drive) as an alternative to iCloud
One-time lifetime purchase – no subscription

quotes.text:
I built WorkSplit, a tiny iPhone app to keep work photos separate from personal ones, stored locally on device.

Problem
As a field technician I often mixed project photos with my private camera roll. That made documentation messy and raised privacy issues when sharing or backing up.

What it does
- Separate, work-only camera inside the app (shoot directly into a selected project/album)
- Optional import from the system Photos app into a project
- Fast retrieval of unsorted shots and quick assignment to a project
- Local-only storage on the iPhone (no accounts, no cloud)

Who it’s for
Tradespeople, technicians, and freelancers who document jobs and want clean separation and privacy.

Link (App Store): https://apps.apple.com/ch/app/id6753669162

I’d love feedback on:
- Does the capture→project flow feel right, or what’s missing for field work?
- Must-have features you’d expect (bulk actions, export flows, metadata)?
- Any iOS edge cases I should account for?

Happy to answer technical or product questions.
– Adrian
